scripts.dev: pnpm db:up && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "pnpm --filter backend start:dev" "pnpm --filter frontend dev"
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && pnpm db:up && pnpm --filter backend migration:run
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck
scripts.sync: git switch main && git pull && pnpm install && pnpm db:up && pnpm --filter backend migration:run
scripts.sync:branch: git fetch origin && git merge --no-commit origin/main && pnpm install && pnpm db:up && pnpm --filter backend migration:run
